newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Glenayre off, ADC up.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Glenayre off, ADC up.

text.p: Glenayre Technologies Inc shares retreated early Thursday as investors sold on the news of quarterly earnings that failed to beat Wall Street expectations, traders said.
In heavy third-market trade before the open, Glenayre fell 2-5/8 to 17.
Last night, the mobile telecommunications equipment company said it earned $0.27 per share in the fiscal fourth quarter, in-line with First Call's analysts' consensus estimates.

ADC Telecommunications Inc shares were quoted above last night's Nasdaq closing mark, a move supported by the announcement last night that ADC expects revenues for the first fiscal quarter ended January 31 to be $256 million, a 57 percent increase over last year's $163 million.
It said revenue contributions from companies acquired since January 31, 1996 account for an estimated $40 million for the quarter.
The shares were bid 36-3/4, ask 36-3/8, better than the last Nasdaq trade of 36-1/4 last night.
Applied Materials Inc gathered steam before the open on news Morgan Stanley raised its recommendation on the stock to strong buy from outperform and set a 12-month target price of $65 per share.
Before the market open, Applied added 1-7/8 to 46.
Ross Stores Inc stood out among a flood of retailers reporting January sales results, rising 1-3/4 to 43-3/4.
The rise was built on Ross's two-for-one stock split, increased dividend, and 15 percent gain in January same-store sales, traders said.
